correctness.rationale: Exact complete face enumeration gives (16,80,144,80); signed orbit representatives determine a nonzero integral cycle with boundary zero. Direct mod-two elimination gives rank 79 for the 144-by-80 third-boundary matrix; this, rational comparison and gcd-one coefficients establish the unique primitive integral generator and exhaustive facet support. All 106 elementary free-face pairs are replayed sequentially against the current deletion, with a closed connected Euler-two surface as target. Independently checked two sphere subcomplexes of each vertex link intersect in a collapsible four-triangle disk, proving the wedge. Rotations extend the verification to all sixteen vertices. No extrapolation to other graphs.

value.rationale: For a well-studied, historically minimal shellable but non-vertex-decomposable flag-complex example, the exact local homotopy types expose how vertex deletion destroys shellability without destroying a genuine sphere collapse. The nonuniform primitive cycle is globally essential on every tetrahedral facet; the gap between integral 96 norm and mod-two 64 support is a meaningful, intrinsic chain-level distinction invisible in the shelling and Betti rank. This is a complete natural invariant/classification for the canonical named example, rather than a random parameter slice.
